children: Robinhood has joined the IPO underwriting syndicate for smart ring maker Oura as a formal underwriter for the first time. According to Foresight News, Oura filed for an initial public offering this week and is expected to be valued at more than $11 billion.
Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Allen & Co., and Jefferies are serving as lead bookrunners.

title: Robinhood Joins Oura IPO as Formal Underwriter
